step1.name: Classify project
step1.action: Determine if project has multiple apps, backend/frontend, DB, auth, or report/source claims. If yes → consider Diagnostic Pack.

step2.name: Run readonly diagnostic
step2.action: Apply Diagnostic Pack checklist. Do NOT modify product code. Record all findings with evidence paths.

step3.name: Decide next action based on user goal

options.action: Extract evidence. Stop after diagnostic. Do NOT repair. Lessons → Factory workflow.
Review findings. Decide which to repair. Run targeted repair phase (not full rewrite).
Run repair on critical+high findings only. Avoid scope creep.

step4.name: If repairing
step4.action: Fix only scoped findings. Do NOT rewrite project. Do NOT introduce new frameworks. Verify repairs with tests.

step5.name: Do not drift
step5.action: If the main goal is Codex Factory improvement, do NOT let real project repair become the main line. SkillMarket repair stopped after critical+high. Correct.

triggerRules.condition: Project has multiple apps (frontend + backend + admin)
Project has report/docs making implementation claims
Project has auth, permissions, or sensitive data
Project claims tests or code quality

triggerRules.action: USE QUICK MODE (~12 items, skip CANNOT_EVALUATE)

reason: Diagnostic Pack found 14 defects on SkillMarket with single-agent readonly mode. Multi-agent would add overhead without better detection for this project class. Prefer Reviewer-Verifier before Agent Company.
